diagnoses.description: Skill documentation and implementation encode a special-case contract that allows edges to target a non-existent node named "End". This conflicts with the task constraint that all edge targets must exist (except possibly a terminal last node) and can cause validators to pass graphs that will fail downstream checks (e.g., reachability, existence, DOT/JSON consistency).
diagnoses.evidence: In dialogue-graph/scripts/dialogue_graph.py Graph.validate(): `if edge.target not in self.nodes and edge.target != "End": errors.append(...)` explicitly exempts missing "End". Meanwhile visualize() always adds an 'End' node regardless of whether it exists in graph.nodes, creating a mismatch between serialized JSON (no End node) and visualization (End node present). The SKILL.md 'Adding Edges' example uses `target="End"` without adding an End node, reinforcing the inconsistent contract.

diagnoses.description: The skill lacks explicit guidance and checks for reachability from the first node and for deterministic export ordering, which can cause failures against constraints requiring all nodes reachable from the first node and can make tests flaky if node order is assumed.
diagnoses.evidence: Task constraint (1) requires reachability from the first node. Graph.validate() only checks missing endpoints, not reachability. Graph.to_dict() exports nodes via dict iteration order, which depends on insertion order and may differ if parser builds nodes in varying sequences; some validators/tests expect stable ordering.

quality_impact.rationale: Removes the incorrect implicit 'End' exemption that can let invalid graphs pass validation and fixes visualization/serialization mismatch by visualizing only explicit nodes. Adds reachability validation required by constraints and stabilizes export ordering to reduce flaky validations.

trigger_precision.rationale: Changes are confined to the dialogue-graph skill’s documented 'Adding Edges'/'Export' contract and the concrete End-handling/validation logic, without embedding task-instance parsing rules. The updates generalize to any dialogue graph builder.

instruction_compliance.rationale: Attributes the defect to deficient Skill content (special-cased End, missing reachability check, inconsistent export vs visualize) rather than agent behavior, and makes required actions explicit in docs (add explicit End node; all targets must exist).

solution_path_coverage.rationale: Supports common execution paths: explicit terminal nodes, multiple paths converging to End, and graphs without End. Adds reachability detection and deterministic export. Does not overconstrain edge text formats or node types, preserving flexibility.

skillaxe_evaluation.overall_rationale: The bundle’s End-node convention was internally inconsistent (validator allowed missing End; visualizer always drew End; exporter omitted it), which can cause downstream failures. The repair aligns docs and code around an explicit-node contract, adds reachability validation per constraints, and improves export determinism while preserving unrelated functionality.
